resources.intake:
What You Need to Apply
To apply, you must upload all of these:
•A photo ID for the main person applying.
•A lease or rental agreement.
•Proof of income for all adults in your home (like pay stubs or benefit letters).
•A demand for rent, eviction notice, or other proof that you are at risk of losing housing.
•A recent utility bill (if you are asking for help with utilities).
We can only look at complete applications. If documents are missing, we will not be able to review your application.
resources.eligibility:
You can apply if:
•You are renting in Denver County, Adams County, Arapahoe County or Jefferson County. 
•You are at risk of losing your housing (for example, you got a notice saying you owe rent or might be evicted).
•Your income is low (at or below 30%-50% of Area Median Income).
• You have not received rental help from JFS in the last 12 months.
•You are not getting ongoing help with rent from another program.
•You can show proof of your current housing (like a lease or rental agreement).
•You can show proof of income for all adults in your household.
